name: phase2_fp_reduction
description: Controlled false-positive reduction experiments around the frozen learned policy.

selection_rule.constraint: validation recall >= original learned policy validation recall - recall_tolerance

reporting_reward: original InvestigationRewardConfig (TP +2, FP -1.5, FN -2, TN 0, cost 0.1 per check)

probability_threshold.description: No investigation; flag if calibrated p >= tau

agent_calibrated_veto.description: Original agent runs unchanged; a FLAG is kept only if calibrated p >= tau

bayes_cost_rule.description: No investigation; flag if calibrated p exceeds the expected-reward break-even point for a cost setting (no tuning)

reward_retrained_policy.description: Fitted Q retrained on S1-S10 with the original procedure and an alternative reward
reward_retrained_policy.selection_uses: mean of validation metrics across seeds

notes: Retraining the original reward reproduces training losses closely but not bit-exactly (hardware nondeterminism); test decision agreement with the production checkpoint is 91.2%. Variants are therefore compared with 'original_reward_retrain' trained under identical conditions, using three seeds.
